prompt: A cinematic film still captures a bustling shipyard dock under an overcast sky. On the far left, a tall crane looms above the scene, its metal arm extended. Next to the crane stands a woman in a yellow raincoat, holding a clipboard tightly. She is looking at a man in a blue hard hat who stands center-left, gesturing with his right hand toward the water. The man in the blue hard hat is next to a large coil of thick rope lying on the wet concrete. Sitting on the rope is a small brown dog, panting slightly. To the right of the dog, a rusted anchor rests heavily on the ground. A child in a striped shirt points at the anchor, standing beside an older woman in a grey shawl. The older woman holds a paper bag containing fresh bread. In the center foreground, a fisherman in a green sweater mends a net, his hands busy with the mesh. Beside him sits a wooden crate filled with silver fish. A seagull perches on the edge of the crate, watching the fisherman closely. Behind the fisherman, a sailor in a white uniform leans against a stack of shipping containers, arms crossed. The sailor is looking at a mechanic in oil-stained coveralls who kneels near a forklift on the right side. The mechanic holds a wrench in one hand and wipes grease from his forehead with the other. Near the forklift, a stray cat hides behind a pallet of crates, eyes wide. Above the scene, a flock of three distant birds flies in formation. In the background, a cargo ship dominates the horizon, its hull painted red. A tugboat moves slowly in the water, creating gentle ripples. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no digital signage or electronic screens anywhere in the frame. There is no vegetation or trees along the dock edges.
